Closing to REOPEN non-draft — the branch and its commits are unchanged and nothing is being abandoned.

This PR is green on all four required checks with mergeable_state clean, is declared Tier-1 `landing: "self"`, and has `.github/pr-automerge-requests/` armed — and it cannot land, because it is a DRAFT. `claude-pr-automerge` refuses to un-draft a PR it did not itself open (by design: a draft is this repo's marker for "prepared, not approved", and Tier-2/Tier-3 PRs rely on that). From a web session `update_pull_request(draft=false)` and `merge_pull_request` both return 403 Resource not accessible by integration, so there is no way to flip it in place.

The root cause was using pr-opener for a SELF-LAND PR. pr-opener honours the harness's draft convention; claude-pr-automerge creates its PRs born ready (draft: false), which IS the request being fulfilled. For a Tier-1 self-land the automerge relay should open the PR, and pr-opener should not be involved.

A successor PR opens automatically from the same branch on the next push to its automerge-request file. Filed as BL-20260904-A-TIER-1-SELF-LAND-PR-OPENED-BY-PR-OPENER-IS-A-DRAFT-AND-CAN-NEVER-SELF-LAND-FROM-A-WEB-SESSION.
